findings.note: The Lightning's Oct 29 game-day preview lists Kucherov on the top line with Gage Goncalves and Brayden Point, using lines from Saturday's game. It flags no injury and says the lines could still change.
Kucherov has a team-high 14 points (4 goals, 10 assists) in 11 games, or 1.27 points per game. That is strong, but the Over needs at least 2 points in one game, which is above his per-game average.
ESPN's game page says Winnipeg brings a losing streak into Tampa. Kyle Connor leads the Jets with 9 goals, and this is the first meeting of the season between the teams.
